title: Trump asks Supreme Court to block California ballots

slides.headline: Trump asks Supreme Court to block California ballots
slides.subtitle: The request targets 20,000 ballots ahead of midterms.

slides.explanation: To put that in perspective, 20,000 people is roughly the seating capacity of a large professional basketball arena. That is the size of this dispute.

slides.headline: Blocking these votes could disenfranchise eligible US citizens
slides.explanation: California officials argue that targeting suspected noncitizens risks throwing out legitimate votes from eligible Americans.
slides.say: There is a major risk here.

slides.explanation: This story is verified by three independent outlets including Al Jazeera, Deutsche Welle, and the Guardian.

caption:
Donald Trump has filed an emergency request with the Supreme Court to block 20,000 California ballots.

The move centers on concerns about noncitizens casting votes in the upcoming midterms.

California officials have pushed back hard against the request. They argue that any broad attempt to invalidate these specific ballots could accidentally disenfranchise legitimate American voters who have every right to participate in the election.

It is a high-stakes legal battle that touches on both election security and the fundamental right to vote. We are watching the Supreme Court's response closely as the midterms approach.
